name: Home Before Dark
description: Young investigative journalist Hilde Lisko moves with her family to the small town her father left behind, only to unearth shocking secrets in her pursuit of the truth.

videos.title: Magic Hour
videos.overview: Young reporter Hilde Lisko and her family are settling into their new life in a small town—until a shocking event changes everything.

videos.title: Never Be the Same
videos.overview: Hilde learns more about Erie Harbor's secrets. Her father, Matt, is forced to face his past and reconnect with his own father.

videos.title: Sting Like a Bee
videos.overview: Chasing down a dangerous lead brings Hilde face-to-face with a potential suspect. Matt's run-in with an old friend spirals out of control.

videos.title: The Bird, Man
videos.overview: Hilde, Donny, and Spoon track down Birdman, a mysterious outcast who may have crucial information about the Richie Fife case.

videos.title: The Green Bike
videos.overview: Convinced that the wrong person was convicted in the Richie Fife case 30 years ago, Hilde sets out to prove it.

videos.title: 88 Miles an Hour
videos.overview: As the '80s dance looms, Hilde and Matt find a promising new lead in the investigation. Frank breaks rank to get to the root of the case.

videos.title: Search Party
videos.overview: When Hilde goes missing, Matt is forced to confront his worst nightmare.

videos.title: The Future is Female
videos.overview: Hilde creates a movement to root out corruption in Erie Harbor. Matt and Bridget try to mend their relationship.

videos.title: Superhero Monster Slayer
videos.overview: A break in the Richie Fife case results in a surprise arrest. Matt and Hilde take a road trip to learn more about the suspect.

videos.title: Bigger Than All of Us
videos.overview: Significant new evidence is dredged up from a nearby lake. Hilde discovers that it's the beginning of a much larger mystery.

videos.title: Not Giving Up
videos.overview: Hilde struggles to let the mystery of Richie Fife go, even as a mysterious explosion leads her to new secrets buried in Erie Harbor's past.

videos.title: I Believe You
videos.overview: A blackout complicates Hilde's investigation. Matt and Bridget discover that Wott Management is not what it seems.

videos.title: Fighting His Ghost
videos.overview: Hilde follows a lead in hopes of saving her grandfather. Matt and Bridget struggle with parenting a newly rebellious Izzy.

videos.title: Dark Rooms
videos.overview: Following the money, Hilde is drawn to the most powerful company in Erie Harbor. Someone unexpected comes back into Izzy's life.

videos.title: The Black Box
videos.overview: The contents of the black box shock Hilde. Matt realizes how much he never knew about his father.

videos.title: What's Out There
videos.overview: When they venture to a remote island, Hilde and Matt make a troubling discovery in the surrounding lake.

videos.title: Just a Bird
videos.overview: Hilde and her friends face the consequences of their actions. The Liskos try to help Sylvester jog his memory.

videos.title: The Bad Guy
videos.overview: As Hilde tries to make amends with Donny and Spoon, Grant closes in. Spirit Week brings up old fears for Izzy.

videos.title: The Biggest Life
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes the Lisko family. Hilde loses her paper. Izzy takes a stand.

videos.title: The Smoking Gun
videos.overview: Matt and Hilde finally get answers. The Liskos struggle to convince the town to join their fight.
